findings.region: Focused slider thumb, the upper range, centre of the track at about x=640, y=111. The same defect shows in range-focus--dark-390.png at about x=195, y=152.
findings.seen: In dark mode, the ring around the focused blue thumb is separated from the fill by a dark gap. That gap takes the dark body surface colour, and no light hairline surrounds the thumb.
findings.expected: Bootstrap 5.3.8 scss/forms/_form-range.scss, `.form-range:focus::-webkit-slider-thumb` and `::-moz-range-thumb`, sets `box-shadow: $form-range-thumb-focus-box-shadow`. In scss/_variables.scss that value is `0 0 0 1px $body-bg, $input-focus-box-shadow`. `$body-bg` is the Sass `$white`, so the value compiles to `#fff` and does not change with the colour mode. Bootstrap therefore draws a white 1px hairline between the thumb and the ring in dark mode too. Veneer's src/styles/components/_form-range.scss, in the focus rule inside the `@each $thumb` loop, paints that hairline with `var(--vn-surface-body-base)`. That colour is dark in dark mode. The guide's parity row for `.form-range:focus::-webkit-slider-thumb` calls this change `tokenized`, but the two values match only in light mode. The fix is to paint the hairline with the white palette entry (`var(--vn-palette-white-base)`) instead of the body surface.

findings.region: Focused 'Email a receipt' checkbox at about x=7, y=109. The same ring appears in the other form-check-box-focus variants and on the range-focus thumbs.
findings.seen: The focus ring around the checkbox looks thinner and more saturated than Bootstrap's pale 4px halo. The ring is also cut off on its left side at the page edge.
findings.expected: Bootstrap 5.3.8 scss/forms/_form-check.scss, `.form-check-input:focus`, sets `box-shadow: $form-check-input-focus-box-shadow`, which is `$input-btn-focus-box-shadow`. In scss/_variables.scss that value compiles to `0 0 0 .25rem rgba(13,110,253,.25)`: a 4px ring at 25% opacity. Veneer's `.form-check-input:focus` reads `var(--vn-focus-width) var(--vn-focus-color)`. In src/styles/_tokens.scss those tokens resolve to 0.1875rem, which is 3px, and to the primary colour at 45%. Veneer's guide lists this as a deliberate token retune, so the departure is declared and is not an accident. The frame cannot show a 1px difference in width or an exact alpha value, so this reading is approximate. The left-side cut-off is a framing artifact and is not a fidelity defect.

clean: form-check-box: I held the state-truth lens. In every variant, the resting checkbox shows an empty box with a faint border and an unchecked label. Bootstrap's `.form-check-input` in forms/_form-check.scss draws it the same way.

form-check-box-focus: The 'Email a receipt' box shows a light-blue border and a translucent blue ring. Its resting sibling has neither. This matches Bootstrap's `.form-check-input:focus`, which sets border-color and box-shadow to $form-check-input-focus-box-shadow, equal to $focus-ring-box-shadow (_variables.scss, $form-check-input-focus-box-shadow). The ring shows in light and dark, at 1280 and at 390.

form-check-box-indeterminate: The box is filled with the primary colour and carries a white dash. This matches `.form-check-input[type=checkbox]:indeterminate` in _form-check.scss. It is clearly different from the empty resting box in all variants.
form-check-checked: The box is filled with the primary colour and carries a white check mark. This matches `.form-check-input:checked` and `[type=checkbox]` in _form-check.scss, in all variants.

form-check-disabled: The box and the 'Add gift wrap' label are both visibly faded compared with the resting row. This matches `.form-check-input:disabled` (opacity) and the disabled label rule in _form-check.scss, in all variants.

form-check-inline: 'Morning' and 'Evening' sit on one line with a gap between them. This matches the `.form-check-inline` rule in _form-check.scss (display inline-block, margin-right), in all variants.

form-check-radios: 'Ship by post' is an empty round control. 'Collect in store' is a primary-filled circle with a white centre dot. This matches `[type=radio]` rounded plus `:checked[type=radio]` in _form-check.scss, in all variants.

form-check-reverse: The label is right-aligned and the checkbox sits on its right at the container's end edge. This matches `.form-check-reverse` in _form-check.scss (text-align end, input floated end), in all variants.

form-check-switch: The unchecked switch shows a pill track with a grey knob at the start. The knob is dark-translucent in light mode and light-translucent in dark mode. This matches `.form-switch .form-check-input` and $form-switch-color-dark in _variables-dark.scss.

form-check-switch-checked: The track is primary-filled and the white knob sits at the end. This matches `.form-switch .form-check-input:checked` (background-position right, $form-switch-checked-bg-image), clearly different from the resting switch in all variants.
form-check-switch-disabled: The switch and the 'Offline orders' label are visibly faded compared with the resting switch, in all variants. This matches the disabled opacity rules in _form-check.scss.

form-check-switch-reverse: The label sits at the end edge and the switch is on its right. The knob stays at the unchecked start position. This matches `.form-switch.form-check-reverse` in _form-check.scss, in all variants.

range: The track is a full-width rounded bar and the thumb is primary-coloured at the midpoint. The track is light grey in light mode and dark grey in dark mode. This matches `.form-range` track and thumb rules in _form-range.scss.

range-disabled: The thumb is painted in the secondary text colour, dark grey in light mode and light grey in dark mode, instead of primary. This matches `.form-range:disabled` in _form-range.scss (thumb background $form-range-thumb-disabled-bg, equal to var(--bs-secondary-color)), in all variants.

range-focus: The focused slider's thumb shows a thin body-colour gap and then a translucent blue ring. The disabled slider next to it has no ring. This matches $form-range-thumb-focus-box-shadow, which is 0 0 0 1px $body-bg followed by $input-focus-box-shadow, applied by `.form-range:focus::-webkit-slider-thumb`. It shows in light and dark, at 1280 and at 390.

findings.region: Focused (upper) range thumb at the centre of the track, around x=640 y=111
findings.seen: In dark mode the focused blue thumb has a dark hairline between the thumb and the outer blue focus ring, so the ring appears to merge into the dark track. In the light sibling (range-focus--light-1280.png), a white 1px hairline separates the thumb from the pale-blue ring. The dark variant diverges because it retunes a hairline that Bootstrap keeps white.
findings.expected: Bootstrap 5.3.8 does not retune this hairline in dark mode. node_modules/bootstrap/scss/_variables.scss sets `$form-range-thumb-focus-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px $body-bg, $input-focus-box-shadow` with the Sass `$body-bg: $white`. forms/_form-range.scss `.form-range:focus &::-webkit-slider-thumb / &::-moz-range-thumb` compiles that to `0 0 0 1px #fff, ...` in both modes, so Bootstrap's dark mode shows a white hairline around the focused thumb. Veneer's src/styles/components/_form-range.scss, in the `.form-range:focus#{$thumb}` rule, paints the hairline with `var(--vn-surface-body-base)`. src/styles/_mixins.scss `theme-tokens` sets that token per mode from the 'canvas' value, so the hairline turns dark in dark mode. The rule's own comment says the release compiles this to `#fff`. The fix is to paint the hairline with the white palette literal, for example `var(--vn-palette-white-base)`, and not with the retuned body surface.

findings.region: Focused (upper) range thumb near the centre of the track, around x=195 y=152
findings.seen: The same dark hairline as at 1280 appears between the focused thumb and its focus ring. range-focus--light-390.png shows the white separator.
findings.expected: Bootstrap 5.3.8 renders the white 1px hairline in dark mode too, from `$form-range-thumb-focus-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px $body-bg, ...` with `$body-bg: $white` in _variables.scss, applied in forms/_form-range.scss `.form-range:focus` thumb rules. The same root cause as the 1280 finding applies: the `.form-range:focus#{$thumb}` rule in src/styles/components/_form-range.scss uses the retuned `--vn-surface-body-base`.

findings.region: The 'Dispatch email' label at the top-left, above the control. The dark-1280, light-390, and dark-390 frames show the same thing.
findings.seen: The label renders at about 14px: 'Dispatch email' spans about 105px, while the same glyphs at 16px measure about 119px. The label is visibly smaller than the control's 16px value 'notices@example.com'. The control's top border sits about 29px down, which fits a 21px line plus the 8px margin.
findings.expected: In Bootstrap, forms/_labels.scss `.form-label` sets only margin-bottom and `font-size($form-label-font-size)`, and `$form-label-font-size` is null. The label therefore inherits the body size, which is `--bs-body-font-size: $font-size-base` (1rem, 16px) from _root.scss. The label should match the control's 16px text, and the control should start 32px down (a 24px line plus 8px). Veneer departs at src/styles/_tokens.scss around line 412: `--bs-body-font-size: var(--vn-size-2)`, which is 0.875rem. src/styles/components/_form-label.scss `.form-label` writes no font-size to make up for it.

findings.region: The help text 'Northworks sends every shipping notice to this address.' under the control. All four variants show it.
findings.seen: The help text renders at about 12px: the sentence ends near x=344. It reads noticeably small beside the 16px control.
findings.expected: Bootstrap forms/_form-text.scss `.form-text` sets `font-size($form-text-font-size)`, which is `$small-font-size` (0.875em). On Bootstrap's 16px body that is 14px, and the sentence would run about 390px. Veneer's `.form-text` in src/styles/components/_form-label.scss also writes 0.875em, but it resolves against the 14px body from `--bs-body-font-size: var(--vn-size-2)` in _tokens.scss, so the text lands at 12.25px.

findings.region: The 'reader@example.com' value across the whole element. The dark-1280, light-390, and dark-390 frames match. In the form-control-text-focus page frames it sits between the color control and the disabled control.
findings.seen: The plaintext value renders at about 14px: it spans about 154px, while the same glyphs at 16px measure about 177px. The box is about 35px tall. In form-control-text-focus--light-1280.png (roughly y 437 to 472) the plaintext is visibly smaller than the 16px 'Recorded name' just below it, and shorter than every standard control.
findings.expected: Bootstrap forms/_form-control.scss `.form-control-plaintext` sets no font-size. It inherits through reboot's `input { font-size: inherit }` from the 1rem body (`--bs-body-font-size: $font-size-base` in _root.scss), so it renders at 16px in a 38px box. That is the height of `.form-control`, which is the reason the class exists: plaintext lines up with a real control. Veneer's `.form-control-plaintext` in src/styles/components/_form-control.scss copies the release rule, but it inherits the 0.875rem body size from src/styles/_tokens.scss around line 412 (`--bs-body-font-size: var(--vn-size-2)`), so both the size and the height miss.

form-control-text: the resting control has a grey border and a placeholder in the secondary colour in all four variants. It stays 38px tall, which matches the default step in _form-control.scss .form-control.

form-control-text-focus: these are page frames. The focused control shows a blue border (#86b7fe) and a ring band along its top edge in the light and dark variants. The two unfocused siblings (the small and large controls) keep grey borders, as .form-control:focus paints. The ring shows only along the top edge because the page edges clip its sides and the next specimen covers its bottom. findings.region: The focused select, the first control under the intro sentence at about y 98-137. The same outline appears in form-select-base-focus--dark-390.png at about y 140-179.
findings.seen: In dark mode the focused select's outline reads as a cyan or sky blue. In the light sibling, form-select-base-focus--light-1280.png, the same outline is a soft periwinkle blue with a pale blue glow. The focus color changes hue between modes. Source corroboration: in src/styles/components/_form-select.scss, the `.form-select:focus` rule paints `box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--vn-focus-width) var(--vn-focus-color)`. `--vn-focus-color` mixes `--vn-color-primary-base`, and the `$dark` map in src/styles/_tokens.scss sets `primary` to `oklch(0.7 0.15 233)`, a cyan-leaning blue. The light map uses `oklch(0.48 0.255 264)`.
findings.expected: The focus color does not change between modes in Bootstrap 5.3.8. All of these are compiled Sass values. _variables-dark.scss retunes only `$form-select-indicator-dark` for the select and does not touch the focus ring or `$primary`.
